name: SETTE E MEZZO
description: Sette e Mezzo (Italian for seven and a half) is an Italian comparing card game similar to blackjack. Players compete against the dealer to get as close as possible to 7½ without exceeding it. Popular in Italy (especially at Christmas), Spain (Siete y Media) and Brazil (Sete e Meio).

content.text: Sette e Mezzo (Italian for seven and a half) is an Italian comparing card game similar to blackjack. Players compete against the dealer to get as close as possible to 7½ without exceeding it. Popular in Italy (especially at Christmas), Spain (Siete y Media) and Brazil (Sete e Meio).

Country/Region of Origin: Italy (primary); also Spain as Siete y Media and Brazil as Sete e Meio.
Time Period: Traditional; in Italy played especially around Christmas.
Historical Development: Italian comparing card game similar to blackjack; popular in Italy, Spain and Brazil.
Cultural Significance: In Italy traditionally played during Christmas holidays; popular gambling and family game.
